title: EFC — Master Specification v1.1
description: Canonical master specification for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), defining the formal structure, notation, and baseline equations for three tightly coupled base layers: EFC-S (structural/halo layer), EFC-D (energy-flow dynamics), and EFC-C0 (entropy–information capacity mapping). The document provides a compact, mathematically explicit core that higher-level models, simulations, and epistemic layers can reference without ambiguity.

energy_flow_potential.description: Local energy-flow potential coupling mass density and dimensionless entropy into a single field; high density with low entropy yields large Ef, while high entropy suppresses it.

low_entropy_anchor.description: Definition of a low-entropy anchor region A, where coarse-grained entropy density is much lower than the background, serving as seeds for halo formation.

halo_mass_profile.description: Parametric radial mass density profile for EFC-S halos with central density ρ₀ and mass scale radius rₛ.

halo_entropy_profile.description: Parametric dimensionless entropy profile for EFC-S halos with entropy floor S₀ and entropy core radius rₓ.

information_capacity.description: EFC-C0 baseline relation mapping entropy to information capacity at fixed density.

key_results.main_finding: EFC establishes a self-consistent formal framework where galaxy dynamics, expansion history, and information capacity all derive from a single energy-flow potential Ef = ρ(1−S) without invoking dark matter or dark energy as separate components.

sealed_predictions.statement: Galaxy rotation curves can be reproduced from the energy-flow potential Ef = ρ(1−S) using joint density-entropy halo profiles without any dark-matter component.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Systematic failure to fit observed rotation curves across diverse galaxy morphologies using EFC-S/D halo profiles.

sealed_predictions.statement: The effective expansion history H(z) derived from EFC energy-flow and entropy evolution reproduces observed cosmic expansion without a cosmological constant Λ.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: EFC-derived H(z) deviating from observed BAO + SNIa expansion history beyond acceptable statistical thresholds.

kill_criteria: KC1: The energy-flow potential Ef = ρ(1−S) is shown to be mathematically incapable of producing flat or rising rotation curves for any physically reasonable halo profile parameterisation.
KC2: Observed galaxy clusters or halos are found where low-entropy anchor regions (⟨s⟩_A ≪ ⟨s⟩_background) do not correlate with structure formation sites, contradicting the EFC-S foundation.
KC3: The entropy–information capacity mapping I(S) ∝ (1−S) is demonstrated to violate known thermodynamic or information-theoretic bounds in astrophysical contexts.
KC4: EFC-D derived effective acceleration from spatial gradients of Ef systematically fails to match observed gravitational lensing profiles in galaxy clusters.
KC5: No parameterisation of halo shape functions f(r/rₛ) and g(r/rₓ) can simultaneously fit observed mass density distributions and entropy profiles in well-resolved galaxy systems.
